changes.value: A being enters a square within 3 squares of a Deadly Carnivorous Plant.

Acrobatics (DC 24): The character makes this check as a part of a Move Action; if the check is successful, the character can pass within 3 squares of a Deadly Carnivorous Plant during that Move Action without triggering the Hazard. Knowledge (Life Sciences) (DC 19): The character identifies the Deadly Carnivorous Plant.
Special: A being reduced to 0 Hit Points by a Deadly Carnivorous Plant takes a -10 penalty to Endurance checks as long as it remains within 3 squares of the Hazard.

system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions

See also: Hazards

A Carnivorous Plant lashes out at a nearby creature, trying to drain it of its life essence.

Durace is home to many species of meat-eating plants. Though fauna is rare on the planet, these plants can consume creatures of up to Large size, living on the nutrition taken from those creatures for years at a time.

Deadly Carnivorous Plants Statistics (CL 11)

Keywords: Natural

Trigger: A being enters a square within 3 squares of a Deadly Carnivorous Plant.

Attack: +13 vs Reflex Defense

Recurrence: Each round, on Initiative Count (Initiative +10)

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Acrobatics (DC 24): The character makes this check as a part of a Move Action; if the check is successful, the character can pass within 3 squares of a Deadly Carnivorous Plant during that Move Action without triggering the Hazard.
  • Knowledge (Life Sciences) (DC 19): The character identifies the Deadly Carnivorous Plant.

Special: A being reduced to 0 Hit Points by a Deadly Carnivorous Plant takes a -10 penalty to Endurance checks as long as it remains within 3 squares of the Hazard.
